notes: The frost fades in when the panel comes to rest (CEO: "when it comes back can you animate it in from zero transparency?"). A background image cannot be faded, so the frost is its own layer inside the card and the card keeps its plain tint…

Out is still instant and only the return is animated: the duration travels with the opacity, so a panel that starts moving drops its wrong picture at once. Measured on a drag: opacity 1 to 0 within 100ms of the first movement, then 0 to 1…
